Owen (Finance): Quick FYI  new expedited procurement path for launch-critical contracts. Effective immediately. Short guide here: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/FIN/pages/Launch+Expedite :rocket:

Priya M: What qualifies as launch-critical?

Owen (Finance): Anything that will block a customer-facing deploy or public launch within 10 business days. Must include PM + Eng manager sign-off in the ticket.

DevOps (Infra): How do we request expedite?

Owen (Finance): Create procurement ticket and add tag "launch-expedite". In the ticket include: 1) reason, 2) deadline, 3) PM & Eng manager approvals, 4) vendor quote + SOW. We'll try same-day triage.

Sasha (Accounting): Extra: if invoice needs same-week payment include PO#, billing email, and mark "fast-pay" in the ticket. Missing fields = normal cycle.

procure-bot: procurement ticket created: FIN-2026-9988 by DevOps (Infra)  status: awaiting finance intake.

DevOps (Infra): Filed FIN-2026-9988 with quote and PM sign-off. Need decision before EOD Friday.

Owen (Finance): Got it  we'll triage today. If Legal needs to review, that may add time; include a short note on contract levers you'd accept (eg no SLA change).

Priya M: One more q  are there spend caps on expedites?

Owen (Finance): No hard cap, but CFO-level approval required for commitments > $75k. If you anticipate that, add CFO approval to the ticket to speed routing.

DevOps (Infra): Thanks, attaching CFO note now.

Sasha (Accounting): I'll prep the PO template for fast-pay and email AP reminder to vendors once invoice arrives.

Owen (Finance): TL;DR: use "launch-expedite" tag, include PM+Eng sign-off, attach SOW + quote, CFO approval if >$75k. Docs: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/FIN/pages/Launch+Expedite :white_check_mark:

Priya M: Saved. :thumbsup:
